checks.name: phase-c-sources-exist
command: set -euo pipefail; for f in Source/DSP/MeterTap.h Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.h Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.cpp Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp tests/SeedingTests.cpp tests/EngineTests.cpp; do test -f "$f"; done

checks.name: cmake-registers-phase-c-sources
command: set -euo pipefail; for s in MeterTap.cpp ShredDoubleEngine.cpp tests/SeedingTests.cpp tests/EngineTests.cpp; do grep -q "$s" CMakeLists.txt; done

checks.name: rt-safety-grep-engine
command: set -euo pipefail; ! grep -E 'std::random_device|malloc\(|std::mutex|std::lock_guard' Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.cpp Source/PluginProcessor.cpp; grep -q 'ScopedNoDenormals' Source/PluginProcessor.cpp

checks.name: build-and-ctest-phase-c
command: set -euo pipefail; find_cmake(){ if command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v cmake; return; fi; shopt -s nullglob; cands=("$HOME"/.local/share/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/clion/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake "$HOME"/.local/share/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/clion/*/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake /opt/clion/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake /snap/clion/current/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake); shopt -u nullglob; for c in "${cands[@]}"; do if [[ -x "$c" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$c"; return; fi; done; return 1; }; if [[ -x scripts/build_all.sh ]]; then bash scripts/build_all.sh; else CMAKE_BIN="$(find_cmake)"; "$CMAKE_BIN" -S . -B build/linux-relwithdebinfo -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo; "$CMAKE_BIN" --build build/linux-relwithdebinfo --config RelWithDebInfo --parallel; fi; if command -v ctest >/dev/null 2>&1; then ctest --test-dir build/linux-relwithdebinfo -C RelWithDebInfo --output-on-failure || ctest --test-dir build -C RelWithDebInfo --output-on-failure; fi
